$comment: Real SEC EDGAR Exhibit 21 documents, retrieved 2026-08-03 and vendored verbatim (byte-for-byte, including
the SGML <DOCUMENT> wrapper EDGAR's archive serves them inside). US federal government publication — public
domain, no licence obligation. Each entry records exactly where the file came from so a reviewer can refetch
Two of the registrants below are NOT the company whose name was queried: 'AlTi Global, Inc.' came back for a
query of 'Altice USA, Inc.', and 'WidePoint Corp' for 'WideOpenWest, Inc.'. Both are recorded under their
TRUE registrant name. They are kept deliberately — they are the measured evidence that name-only CIK
resolution produces confident false identity links, which is why the ingest path requires corroboration.
